module.purpose: Defines the API v1 POST endpoint that authorizes booking ownership, marks the request as API-originated, and delegates booking creation to shared booking logic.
module.summary: This module is a Next.js API route for creating bookings. It enriches incoming request data with the API v1 creation source, adjusts the effective user for system-wide administrators and organization administrators, resolves accessible users, and invokes centralized booking validation and creation. A specific no-available-users error is translated into an HTTP 400 response while all other failures propagate to the shared responder.
module.businessContext: Supports external clients creating calendar bookings through the API. Failure prevents appointments from being scheduled and may return authorization, validation, availability, or booking-creation errors.
functions: handler (~L214-251): Authorizes booking ownership and delegates API booking creation.
systemCapabilities: Restrict organization administrators to accessible users
Translate availability failures into HTTP responses

io: Returns the delegated booking result through the API responder.
mutationOfArg: Mutates req.body by adding creationSource: CreationSource.API_V1.

contractsConsumed.name: handleNewBooking
contractsConsumed.shape: handleNewBooking({ bookingData: req.body, userId, hostname: req.headers.host || "", forcedSlug: req.headers["x-cal-force-slug"] as string | undefined }, getBookingDataSchemaForApi)

sectionMap.name: request identity extraction
sectionMap.intent: Reads administrator flags and establishes the initial effective user.

sectionMap.name: API source enrichment
sectionMap.intent: Adds the API v1 creation source to the incoming booking body.

sectionMap.name: system administrator override
sectionMap.intent: Allows system administrators to select the requested booking user.

sectionMap.name: organization access resolution
sectionMap.intent: Restricts organization administrators to an accessible requested user.

sectionMap.name: organization administrator branch
sectionMap.intent: Resolves accessible users when organization-level administration applies.

sectionMap.name: booking delegation
sectionMap.intent: Delegates validation and booking creation with request-derived metadata.

sectionMap.name: known availability error mapping

edgeCases.behavior: Passes an empty string as hostname to booking creation.

edgeCases.inputShape: System-wide administrator with a requested body userId
edgeCases.behavior: Uses the requested body userId instead of the authenticated userId.

edgeCases.inputShape: Organization administrator requesting an inaccessible user
edgeCases.behavior: Uses the first accessible user returned, or retains the current userId when none is returned.
Throws an HttpError with status code 400 and the original error message.

boundaryConditions.intent: Identifies the specific availability failure that must become a client error.

errorHandling.action: Maps ErrorCode.NoAvailableUsersFound to an HTTP 400 error.
Rethrows every error that is not the recognized no-available-users error.

invariants.description: Every delegated booking payload is marked as originating from API v1.
Booking creation always receives an effective userId.
User access resolution completes before booking creation is delegated.
Only the recognized no-available-users error is converted; other errors propagate.

assumptions.description: The request is expected to have authentication-derived userId and administrator flags.
handleNewBooking and getBookingDataSchemaForApi define the accepted booking body shape and validation rules.
The shared responder is responsible for converting handler results and propagated errors into API responses.

ambiguities.question: How are req.userId and administrator flags populated before this handler runs?
What booking result shape and additional side effects does handleNewBooking produce?
ambiguities.affects: return contract and booking creation behavior

concurrencyModel.notes: Each request performs independent asynchronous user-access resolution and booking creation; no module-level mutable state is used.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A valid booking request is submitted through the API endpoint.
given: req.body contains eventTypeId, start, responses, timeZone, language, and metadata
moduleContractTests.then: handleNewBooking receives bookingData containing creationSource: CreationSource.API_V1 and the request returns its result
moduleContractTests.rationale: Ensures API-created bookings are marked with the required API_V1 creation source.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A system-wide administrator submits a booking for an explicitly selected user.
moduleContractTests.then: handleNewBooking receives userId equal to req.body.userId

moduleContractTests.scenario: An organization owner or administrator submits a booking for a requested member.
moduleContractTests.then: handleNewBooking receives the first accessible user ID, or the existing userId when none is returned
moduleContractTests.rationale: Ensures organization-scoped authorization controls the booking owner.

moduleContractTests.scenario: Booking creation fails because no available users are found.
given: handleNewBooking throws an error whose message is ErrorCode.NoAvailableUsersFound
moduleContractTests.then: the endpoint throws HttpError with statusCode: 400 and message equal to knownError.message
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins the documented bad-request mapping for unavailable users.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A booking request includes the x-cal-force-slug header.
moduleContractTests.then: handleNewBooking receives forcedSlug equal to req.headers["x-cal-force-slug"]
moduleContractTests.rationale: Preserves routing override propagation to booking creation.
